filmBrief: Seven phrases from Drew’s supplied chant image, with the exact ppp, pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff progression. One ready screen. Each scene holds for the teacher and student echo. The ghost appears only on the final cue. No automatic speech, soundtrack, or scene advance.
